{{Top}}
[[File:Life_Day_incense_burner.jpg|thumb|250px|A Wookiee incense burner]]
{{Quote|The rose smell was very strong, as if the sun were beating the fragrance out of them. Burning them like slow incense.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
'''Incense''' was any substance that was used to produce a fragrant and pleasant odor when it was burned. Certain types of incense favored [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]], which is why the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="YDR" /> and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] alike sometimes used them.<ref name="BTS">''[[Star Wars: Beware the Sith]]''</ref> [[Species/Legends|Species]] as diverse as the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Yuuzhan Vong]],<ref name="aoc2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref> [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] all used incense.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> To the olfactory system of [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] incense smelled like burning [[thicklube]].<ref name="YDR" />

Incense was burnt by shopkeepers and residents of [[Barons Hed]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] in order to cover the odor of [[urine/Legends|urine]] and vomit permeating the alleys of the [[Low Town]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
